title: Baghdad, Iraq – Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, speaking from the site of General Qassem Soleimani’s martyrdom in Baghdad, declared that during the Ramadan War, adversaries fully grasped the power of Iran's resistance.
text:
Baghdad, Iraq – Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, speaking from the site of General Qassem Soleimani’s martyrdom in Baghdad, declared that during the Ramadan War, adversaries fully grasped the power of Iran's resistance."

"Qalibaf further stated that the resistance movement has now surpassed the boundaries of Iran, Iraq, and the wider region, asserting that it has evolved into a truly global phenomenon."

""
"Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Head of Iran's negotiating team and Parliament Speaker (Farsi): "Through the Ramadan war, they understood the power of Iran's resistance. The resistance in Iraq is also one of the elements of this country's power. Over the years, the discourse of resistance has transcended the borders of Iran, Iraq, and the region, becoming global. Today, the dirty reality of the Zionists has been revealed to the nations of the world, and Israel is recognized as the enemy of humanity.
